assetProfile.longBusinessSummary: QUALCOMM Incorporated engages in the development and commercialization of foundational technologies for the wireless industry worldwide. Further, it provides security and intelligence services for unmanaged networks through software-based network security solutions. The company is in collaboration with Amazon to enable customized silicon at scale for large-scale AI data centers. QUALCOMM Incorporated was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in San Diego, California.
